=== [[File:Member.webp]] ===
Default rank given to everybody.

=== [[File:Avid.webp]] ===
Single purchase rank giving a few abilities on the SMP:
* Custom prefix in chat [Avid]
* Ability to use /sit and /lay
* Ability to use colors in chat and format [Bold, italic or underlined]
* Ability to showcase items in chat with [item]
* Ability to use /seen command [used to see when a player was last logged in]
* Access to Donor Chat on discord
And on Discord:
* Access to Donor Chat
* View in-game-chat channel

=== [[File:Devotee.webp]] ===
Monthly payment rank giving all the benefits of Avid along with some extra ones on the SMP:
* Custom prefix in chat [Devotee]
* Ability to use /spin
* Ability to showcase your inventory and enderchest in chat with [inv] and [ender]
* Ability to start any event by doing /events*
* Ability to start any KOTH by doing /start koth*
And on Discord:
* Access to Donor Chat on discord
* View in-game-chat channel
* Ability to send messages through the in-game-chat channel
* Avatar head emoji
<br>
&#42;Not yet implemented

=== [[File:Media.webp]] ===
Makes content about the server to advertise.

=== [[File:Helper.webp]] ===
Helpers answer questions, mute, warn and kick people.

=== [[File:Builder.webp]] ===
Builds structures to be used in new updates.

=== [[File:Mod.webp]] ===
Moderates the server, looks for cheaters, warns, mutes, kicks, bans.

=== [[File:Admin.webp]] ===
General server management, events etc.

=== [[File:Founder.webp]] ===
Highest rank, created the server.

=== Donators Star [[File:Donators Star.webp|frameless]] ===
No longer attainable. Received by buying a rank during the beta or first month after full release.
